assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a SINGLE production-ready 16:9 landscape main-menu BACKGROUND for a dark fantasy tabletop game, not a UI screenshot or montage. Painterly cinematic realism with visible oil-painted material detail, blackened iron, antique muted gold, worn brown leather, deep blue-black stone, warm candlelight. Medieval vaulted council chamber at night. A tabletop in the lower quarter, a restrained cluster of ornate old-gold polyhedral dice and a closed iron-bound codex at the lower-left edge, an antique chalice near the far left, a burning wax candle and several closed books at the far right, subtle hanging dark banners at the outer edges. Camera eye level slightly above the table. Composition is for a centered title and THREE stacked wide menu buttons: the central horizontal 40 percent, from x=30% to 70% and y=8% to 82%, must be especially dark, calm and nearly empty, without bright objects, silhouettes or hard edges. All strong detail remains in the outer 25 percent and bottom 20 percent. The upper central area is a dark recess, not a light window. Keep the table horizon below the lower menu button. Natural chiaroscuro, rich but restrained old gold, no modern objects, no people, no characters, no UI panels, no borders, no lettering, no words, no symbols resembling text, no logos, no watermark. Full-bleed opaque artwork; wide 16:9 composition. Deliver exactly one image.
